steps.description: Referência e-mail montada; delta multicanal depende de aplicação/homologação no SFMC.
currentSql:
SELECT
    e.CPF,
    e.PRI_NOME,
    e.EMAIL,
    e.NR_CELULAR,
    e.FL_BLOQ_CELULAR,
    e.CANAL,
    e.NM_PARCEIRO,
    e.NM_CARTAO,
    e.VL_LIMITE_DISPONIVEL,
    e.DT_ULTIMA_COMPRA,
    m.QT_MODA,
    m.VL_MODA,
    m.DT_ULT_MODA,
    m.QT_SAUDE_BELEZA,
    m.VL_SAUDE_BELEZA,
    m.DT_ULT_SAUDE_BELEZA,
    m.QT_ELETRODOM,
    m.VL_ELETRODOM,
    m.DT_ULT_ELETRODOM,
    m.QT_ELETRONICOS,
    m.VL_ELETRONICOS,
    m.DT_ULT_ELETRONICOS,
    m.QT_BRINQUEDOS,
    m.VL_BRINQUEDOS,
    m.DT_ULT_BRINQUEDOS,
    m.QT_VIAGEM,
    m.VL_VIAGEM,
    m.DT_ULT_VIAGEM,
    m.QT_PET,
    m.VL_PET,
    m.DT_ULT_PET,
    m.VL_GASTO_12M
FROM (
    SELECT
        a.CPF,
        MAX(a.PRI_NOME) AS PRI_NOME,
        MAX(a.EMAIL) AS EMAIL,
        MAX(a.NR_CELULAR) AS NR_CELULAR,
        MAX(
            CASE
                WHEN a.bloqueio_celular = 1 THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS FL_BLOQ_CELULAR,
        MAX(a.CANAL) AS CANAL,
        CASE
            WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT
                CASE
                    WHEN a.CANAL = 'B2B2C'
                        AND a.STATUS = 'NORMAL'
                    THEN NULLIF(
                        UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(a.PRODUTO))),
                        ''
                    )
                END
            ) = 1
            AND MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN a.CANAL = 'B2C'
                        AND a.STATUS = 'NORMAL'
                    THEN 1
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ) = 0
            THEN MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN a.CANAL = 'B2B2C'
                        AND a.STATUS = 'NORMAL'
                    THEN UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(a.PRODUTO)))
                END
            )
            ELSE NULL
        END AS NM_PARCEIRO,
        CONVERT(VARCHAR(150), NULL) AS NM_CARTAO,
        MAX(
            CASE
                WHEN a.STATUS = 'NORMAL'
                THEN a.LIMITE_DISPONIVEL
            END
        ) AS VL_LIMITE_DISPONIVEL,
        MAX(a.DATA_ULTIMA_COMPRA) AS DT_ULTIMA_COMPRA
    FROM [CLIENTES ATIVOS] a
    WHERE a.CANAL IN ('B2C', 'B2B2C')
    GROUP BY a.CPF
    HAVING
        MAX(
            CASE
                WHEN a.STATUS = 'NORMAL'
                    AND a.DATA_ULTIMA_COMPRA >= DATEADD(
                        DAY,
                        -30,
                        CONVERT(DATE, GETDATE())
                    )
                    AND a.LIMITE_DISPONIVEL >= 200
                THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) = 1
        AND MAX(
            CASE
                WHEN a.bloqueio_email = 1 THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) = 0
        AND MAX(
            CASE
                WHEN a.STATUS = 'BLOQUEADO ATRASO' THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) = 0
        AND MAX(LEN(a.EMAIL)) > 0
) e
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        c.CPF,
        SUM(mp.qtd_moda) AS QT_MODA,
        SUM(mp.vlr_moda) AS VL_MODA,
        MAX(mp.dt_ultima_compra_moda) AS DT_ULT_MODA,
        SUM(mp.qtd_saude_beleza) AS QT_SAUDE_BELEZA,
        SUM(mp.vlr_saude_beleza) AS VL_SAUDE_BELEZA,
        MAX(mp.dt_ultima_compra_saude_beleza) AS DT_ULT_SAUDE_BELEZA,
        SUM(mp.qtd_eletrodomesticos) AS QT_ELETRODOM,
        SUM(mp.vlr_eletrodomesticos) AS VL_ELETRODOM,
        MAX(mp.dt_ultima_compra_eletrodomesticos) AS DT_ULT_ELETRODOM,
        SUM(mp.qtd_eletronicos) AS QT_ELETRONICOS,
        SUM(mp.vlr_eletronicos) AS VL_ELETRONICOS,
        MAX(mp.dt_ultima_compra_eletronicos) AS DT_ULT_ELETRONICOS,
        SUM(mp.qtd_brinquedos) AS QT_BRINQUEDOS,
        SUM(mp.vlr_brinquedos) AS VL_BRINQUEDOS,
        MAX(mp.dt_ultima_compra_brinquedos) AS DT_ULT_BRINQUEDOS,
        SUM(mp.qtd_viagem) AS QT_VIAGEM,
        SUM(mp.vlr_viagem) AS VL_VIAGEM,
        MAX(mp.dt_ultima_compra_viagem) AS DT_ULT_VIAGEM,
        SUM(mp.qtd_pet) AS QT_PET,
        SUM(mp.vlr_pet) AS VL_PET,
        MAX(mp.dt_ultima_compra_pet) AS DT_ULT_PET,
        SUM(
            ISNULL(mp.vlr_moda, 0)
            + ISNULL(mp.vlr_saude_beleza, 0)
            + ISNULL(mp.vlr_eletrodomesticos, 0)
            + ISNULL(mp.vlr_eletronicos, 0)
            + ISNULL(mp.vlr_brinquedos, 0)
            + ISNULL(mp.vlr_viagem, 0)
            + ISNULL(mp.vlr_pet, 0)
            + ISNULL(mp.vlr_fora_mvp, 0)
            + ISNULL(mp.vlr_nao_mapeado, 0)
        ) AS VL_GASTO_12M
    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT
            CPF,
            NR_CONTA
        FROM [CLIENTES ATIVOS]
    ) c
    INNER JOIN MAPA_MCC mp
        ON c.NR_CONTA = mp.nr_conta
    GROUP BY c.CPF
) m
    ON e.CPF = m.CPF

steps.title: Acumular participantes
steps.description: Referência e-mail montada; delta multicanal depende de aplicação/homologação no SFMC.
currentSql:
SELECT
    b.CPF,
    'VDV_2026_11_BF' AS ID_SAFRA,
    b.PRI_NOME AS FIRST_NAME,
    b.EMAIL,
    b.NR_CELULAR,
    'BR' AS LOCALE,
    b.FL_BLOQ_CELULAR,
    b.CANAL,
    b.NM_PARCEIRO,
    b.NM_CARTAO,
    b.VL_LIMITE_DISPONIVEL,
    ISNULL(g.G1, 'GENERICO') AS CD_GRUPO,
    g.G2 AS CD_GRUPO_SECUNDARIO,
    CASE
        WHEN ABS(CHECKSUM(b.CPF + 'VDV_CONTROLE') % 100) >= 90
        THEN
            CASE
                WHEN g.G1 IS NULL THEN 'GEN-C'
                ELSE 'SEG-C'
            END
        WHEN g.G1 IS NULL THEN 'GEN-A'
        WHEN ABS(
            CHECKSUM(b.CPF + 'VDV_2026_11_BF') % 2
        ) = 0 THEN 'SEG-A'
        ELSE 'SEG-B'
    END AS DS_CELULA_TESTE,
    'BF26_V1' AS ID_VERSAO_OFERTAS,
    CONVERT(VARCHAR(36), NEWID()) AS ID_ENVIO,
    DATEADD(HOUR, 3, GETDATE()) AS DT_ENTRADA,
    CONVERT(DATETIME, NULL) AS DT_ENVIO
FROM VDV_CRUZAMENTO b
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        r.CPF,
        MAX(
            CASE WHEN r.RN = 1 THEN r.GRUPO END
        ) AS G1,
        MAX(
            CASE WHEN r.RN = 2 THEN r.GRUPO END
        ) AS G2
    FROM (
        SELECT
            u.CPF,
            u.GRUPO,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY u.CPF
                ORDER BY
                    CASE
                        WHEN u.GRUPO = 'FAMILIA_PRESENTES' THEN 0
                        ELSE 1
                    END,
                    u.QT DESC,
                    u.VL DESC,
                    u.PRIORIDADE ASC
            ) AS RN
        FROM (
            SELECT
                c.CPF,
                'MODA' AS GRUPO,
                c.QT_MODA AS QT,
                c.VL_MODA AS VL,
                1 AS PRIORIDADE
            FROM VDV_CRUZAMENTO c
            WHERE
                c.QT_MODA >= 2
                AND c.DT_ULT_MODA >= DATEADD(
                    MONTH,
                    -6,
                    CONVERT(
                        DATE,
                        DATEADD(HOUR, 3, GETDATE())
                    )
                )

            UNION ALL

            SELECT
                c.CPF,
                'SAUDE_BELEZA' AS GRUPO,
                c.QT_SAUDE_BELEZA AS QT,
                c.VL_SAUDE_BELEZA AS VL,
                2 AS PRIORIDADE
            FROM VDV_CRUZAMENTO c
            WHERE
                c.QT_SAUDE_BELEZA >= 2
                AND c.DT_ULT_SAUDE_BELEZA >= DATEADD(
                    MONTH,
                    -6,
                    CONVERT(
                        DATE,
                        DATEADD(HOUR, 3, GETDATE())
                    )
                )

            UNION ALL

            SELECT
                c.CPF,
                'FAMILIA_PRESENTES' AS GRUPO,
                c.QT_BRINQUEDOS AS QT,
                c.VL_BRINQUEDOS AS VL,
                3 AS PRIORIDADE
            FROM VDV_CRUZAMENTO c
            WHERE c.QT_BRINQUEDOS >= 2
        ) u
    ) r
    GROUP BY r.CPF
) g
    ON b.CPF = g.CPF
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM VDV_SAFRA s
    WHERE
        s.CPF = b.CPF
        AND s.ID_SAFRA = 'VDV_2026_11_BF'
)

steps.title: Selecionar a rodada
steps.description: Montagem informada; primeira execução integral pendente.
currentSql:
SELECT
    'BF26_V1_' + CONVERT(
        VARCHAR(8),
        CONVERT(DATE, DATEADD(HOUR, 3, GETDATE())),
        112
    ) AS VERSAO,
    p.GRUPO,
    'TODAS' AS CELULA,
    p.POSICAO,
    p.OFERTA_ID,
    1 AS ATIVA,
    CASE
        WHEN p.GRUPO = 'GENERICO' THEN 'COMPLETAR'
        WHEN p.FAIXA = 1 THEN 'GRUPO'
        WHEN p.FAIXA = 2 THEN 'DESCOBERTA'
        ELSE 'COMPLETAR'
    END AS MOTIVO,
    CONVERT(
        DATE,
        DATEADD(HOUR, 3, GETDATE())
    ) AS DT_RODADA,
    'BF26_V1' AS VERSAO_TEMA
FROM (
    SELECT
        f.GRUPO,
        f.OFERTA_ID,
        f.FAIXA,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY f.GRUPO
            ORDER BY
                f.FAIXA,
                f.ULTIMA_RODADA,
                ISNULL(
                    f.FIM,
                    CONVERT(DATE, '20991231', 112)
                ),
                f.OFERTA_ID
        ) AS POSICAO
    FROM (
        SELECT
            r.GRUPO,
            r.OFERTA_ID,
            r.FIM,
            r.ULTIMA_RODADA,
            CASE
                WHEN r.GRUPO = 'GENERICO' THEN 1
                WHEN r.PROPRIA = 1
                    AND r.RN_TIPO <= 2 THEN 1
                WHEN r.PROPRIA = 0
                    AND r.RN_TIPO = 1 THEN 2
                ELSE 3
            END AS FAIXA
        FROM (
            SELECT
                d.GRUPO,
                d.OFERTA_ID,
                d.FIM,
                d.PROPRIA,
                d.ULTIMA_RODADA,
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                    PARTITION BY
                        d.GRUPO,
                        d.PROPRIA
                    ORDER BY
                        d.ULTIMA_RODADA,
                        ISNULL(
                            d.FIM,
                            CONVERT(DATE, '20991231', 112)
                        ),
                        d.OFERTA_ID
                ) AS RN_TIPO
            FROM (
                SELECT
                    c.GRUPO,
                    c.OFERTA_ID,
                    c.FIM,
                    c.PROPRIA,
                    c.ULTIMA_RODADA,
                    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                        PARTITION BY
                            c.GRUPO,
                            UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(c.MARCA)))
                        ORDER BY
                            c.PROPRIA DESC,
                            c.ULTIMA_RODADA,
                            ISNULL(
                                c.FIM,
                                CONVERT(DATE, '20991231', 112)
                            ),
                            c.OFERTA_ID
                    ) AS RN_MARCA
                FROM (
                    SELECT
                        gg.GRUPO,
                        o.ID AS OFERTA_ID,
                        o.MARCA,
                        o.FIM,
                        CASE
                            WHEN gg.GRUPO = 'GENERICO' THEN 0
                            WHEN o.GRUPO = gg.GRUPO THEN 1
                            ELSE 0
                        END AS PROPRIA,
                        ISNULL(
                            h.ULTIMA_RODADA,
                            CONVERT(DATE, '19000101', 112)
                        ) AS ULTIMA_RODADA
                    FROM (
                        SELECT 'MODA' AS GRUPO

                        UNION ALL

                        SELECT 'SAUDE_BELEZA' AS GRUPO

                        UNION ALL

                        SELECT 'FAMILIA_PRESENTES' AS GRUPO

                        UNION ALL

                        SELECT 'GENERICO' AS GRUPO
                    ) gg
                    CROSS JOIN BRIEFING_OFERTAS_VISA o
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT
                            GRUPO,
                            OFERTA_ID,
                            MAX(DT_RODADA) AS ULTIMA_RODADA
                        FROM VDV_POOL_OFERTAS_GRUPO_POSICAO
                        WHERE
                            POSICAO BETWEEN 1 AND 3
                            AND ATIVA = 1
                            AND VERSAO_TEMA = 'BF26_V1'
                            AND DT_RODADA < CONVERT(
                                DATE,
                                DATEADD(HOUR, 3, GETDATE())
                            )
                        GROUP BY
                            GRUPO,
                            OFERTA_ID
                    ) h
                        ON h.GRUPO = gg.GRUPO
                        AND h.OFERTA_ID = o.ID
                    WHERE
                        o.TIPO = 'OFERTA'
                        AND o.ATIVA = 1
                        AND LEN(
                            LTRIM(RTRIM(o.MARCA))
                        ) > 0
                        AND LEN(
                            LTRIM(RTRIM(o.FOTO))
                        ) > 0
                        AND LEN(
                            LTRIM(RTRIM(o.VALOR))
                        ) > 0
                        AND LEN(
                            LTRIM(RTRIM(o.LINK))
                        ) > 0
                        AND (
                            o.INICIO IS NULL
                            OR o.INICIO <= CONVERT(
                                DATE,
                                DATEADD(HOUR, 3, GETDATE())
                            )
                        )
                        AND (
                            o.FIM IS NULL
                            OR o.FIM >= CONVERT(
                                DATE,
                                DATEADD(HOUR, 3, GETDATE())
                            )
                        )
                ) c
            ) d
            WHERE d.RN_MARCA = 1
        ) r
    ) f
) p
WHERE
    p.POSICAO <= 6
    AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM VDV_POOL_OFERTAS_GRUPO_POSICAO z
        WHERE z.VERSAO = 'BF26_V1_' + CONVERT(
            VARCHAR(8),
            CONVERT(DATE, DATEADD(HOUR, 3, GETDATE())),
            112
        )
    )
    AND 1 = (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM BRIEFING_OFERTAS_VISA t
        WHERE
            t.TIPO = 'TEMA'
            AND t.VERSAO = 'BF26_V1'
            AND t.ATIVA = 1
            AND (
                t.INICIO IS NULL
                OR t.INICIO <= CONVERT(
                    DATE,
                    DATEADD(HOUR, 3, GETDATE())
                )
            )
            AND (
                t.FIM IS NULL
                OR t.FIM >= CONVERT(
                    DATE,
                    DATEADD(HOUR, 3, GETDATE())
                )
            )
    )

steps.title: Selecionar audiência por canal
steps.description: Referência e-mail montada; delta multicanal depende de aplicação/homologação no SFMC.
currentSql:
SELECT
    s.CPF,
    c.PRI_NOME AS FIRST_NAME,
    c.EMAIL,
    c.NR_CELULAR,
    c.FL_BLOQ_CELULAR,
    c.CANAL,
    c.VL_LIMITE_DISPONIVEL,
    c.DT_ULTIMA_COMPRA,
    c.VL_GASTO_12M,
    s.CD_GRUPO,
    s.CD_GRUPO_SECUNDARIO,
    'V1_12M_REC6M' AS CD_REGRA_GRUPO,
    s.DS_CELULA_TESTE,
    s.ID_SAFRA,
    DATEADD(HOUR, 3, GETDATE()) AS DT_ATUALIZACAO,
    c.NM_PARCEIRO,
    c.NM_CARTAO,
    'BR' AS LOCALE,
    'BF26_V1_' + CONVERT(
        VARCHAR(8),
        CONVERT(DATE, DATEADD(HOUR, 3, GETDATE())),
        112
    ) AS ID_VERSAO_OFERTAS,
    s.ID_ENVIO
FROM VDV_SAFRA s
INNER JOIN VDV_CRUZAMENTO c
    ON c.CPF = s.CPF
WHERE
    s.ID_SAFRA = 'VDV_2026_11_BF'
    AND s.DS_CELULA_TESTE IN (
        'SEG-A',
        'SEG-B',
        'GEN-A'
    )
    AND LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(c.EMAIL))) > 0
    AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM _Subscribers sub
        WHERE
            sub.SubscriberKey = s.CPF
            AND sub.Status IN (
                'Unsubscribed',
                'Held'
            )
    )
    AND 1 = (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM BRIEFING_OFERTAS_VISA t
        WHERE
            t.TIPO = 'TEMA'
            AND t.VERSAO = 'BF26_V1'
            AND t.ATIVA = 1
            AND (
                t.INICIO IS NULL
                OR t.INICIO <= CONVERT(
                    DATE,
                    DATEADD(HOUR, 3, GETDATE())
                )
            )
            AND (
                t.FIM IS NULL
                OR t.FIM >= CONVERT(
                    DATE,
                    DATEADD(HOUR, 3, GETDATE())
                )
            )
    )
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM VDV_POOL_OFERTAS_GRUPO_POSICAO p
        INNER JOIN BRIEFING_OFERTAS_VISA o
            ON o.ID = p.OFERTA_ID
            AND o.TIPO = 'OFERTA'
        WHERE
            p.VERSAO = 'BF26_V1_' + CONVERT(
                VARCHAR(8),
                CONVERT(
                    DATE,
                    DATEADD(HOUR, 3, GETDATE())
                ),
                112
            )
            AND p.VERSAO_TEMA = 'BF26_V1'
            AND p.CELULA = 'TODAS'
            AND p.GRUPO = CASE
                WHEN s.DS_CELULA_TESTE IN (
                    'SEG-B',
                    'GEN-A'
                ) THEN 'GENERICO'
                ELSE s.CD_GRUPO
            END
            AND p.POSICAO BETWEEN 1 AND 6
            AND p.ATIVA = 1
            AND o.ATIVA = 1
            AND LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(o.MARCA))) > 0
            AND LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(o.FOTO))) > 0
            AND LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(o.LINK))) > 0
            AND LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(o.VALOR))) > 0
            AND (
                o.INICIO IS NULL
                OR o.INICIO <= CONVERT(
                    DATE,
                    DATEADD(HOUR, 3, GETDATE())
                )
            )
            AND (
                o.FIM IS NULL
                OR o.FIM >= CONVERT(
                    DATE,
                    DATEADD(HOUR, 3, GETDATE())
                )
            )
        GROUP BY p.GRUPO
        HAVING COUNT(
            DISTINCT UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(o.MARCA)))
        ) >= 3
    )

steps.title: Conferir execução
steps.description: Referência e-mail montada; delta multicanal depende de aplicação/homologação no SFMC.
currentSql:
SELECT
    'VDV_2026_11_BF' AS ID_SAFRA,
    DATEADD(HOUR, 3, GETDATE()) AS DT_EXECUCAO,
    f.NR_ORDEM,
    f.ETAPA,
    f.CD_GRUPO,
    f.DS_CELULA_TESTE,
    f.QTD,
    f.PCT_ETAPA_ANTERIOR,
    f.VL_CONTROLE,
    f.DS_STATUS,
    f.DS_OBS
FROM (
    SELECT
        1 AS NR_ORDEM,
        'MAPA_ENTRADA' AS ETAPA,
        'TOTAL' AS CD_GRUPO,
        'TODAS' AS DS_CELULA_TESTE,
        COUNT(*) AS QTD,
        CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(7,4)) AS PCT_ETAPA_ANTERIOR,
        CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS VL_CONTROLE,
        CASE
            WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 'OK'
            ELSE 'ALERTA'
        END AS DS_STATUS,
        CAST(
            CASE
                WHEN COUNT(*) = 0
                THEN 'Entrada vazia, conferir importacao'
            END
            AS VARCHAR(200)
        ) AS DS_OBS
    FROM MAPA_MCC_ENTRADA

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        2,
        'MAPA_TRATADA',
        'TOTAL',
        'TODAS',
        COUNT(*),
        NULL,
        MAX(vlr_moda),
        CASE
            WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 'ALERTA'
            WHEN COUNT(*) <> (
                SELECT COUNT(*)
                FROM MAPA_MCC_ENTRADA
            ) THEN 'ALERTA'
            WHEN SUM(
                CASE
                    WHEN vlr_moda - FLOOR(vlr_moda) <> 0
                    THEN 1 ELSE 0
                END
            ) = 0 THEN 'ALERTA'
            WHEN MAX(vlr_moda) > 500000 THEN 'ALERTA'
            ELSE 'OK'
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN COUNT(*) = 0
            THEN 'Mapa tratado vazio'
            WHEN COUNT(*) <> (
                SELECT COUNT(*)
                FROM MAPA_MCC_ENTRADA
            )
            THEN 'Quantidade diferente da entrada'
            WHEN SUM(
                CASE
                    WHEN vlr_moda - FLOOR(vlr_moda) <> 0
                    THEN 1 ELSE 0
                END
            ) = 0
            THEN 'Sem centavos em Moda, conferir conversao'
            WHEN MAX(vlr_moda) > 500000
            THEN 'Valor maximo de Moda acima do esperado'
            ELSE NULL
        END
    FROM MAPA_MCC

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        3,
        'CRUZAMENTO',
        'TOTAL',
        'TODAS',
        COUNT(*),
        NULL,
        NULL,
        CASE
            WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 'OK'
            ELSE 'ALERTA'
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN COUNT(*) = 0
            THEN 'Nenhum cliente elegivel no cruzamento'
            ELSE NULL
        END
    FROM VDV_CRUZAMENTO

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        4,
        'SAFRA_TOTAL',
        'TOTAL',
        'TODAS',
        COUNT(*),
        NULL,
        NULL,
        CASE
            WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 'OK'
            ELSE 'ALERTA'
        END,
        'Participantes acumulados, inclusive controles'
    FROM VDV_SAFRA
    WHERE ID_SAFRA = 'VDV_2026_11_BF'

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        5,
        'SAFRA',
        s.CD_GRUPO,
        s.DS_CELULA_TESTE,
        COUNT(*),
        CAST(
            CAST(COUNT(*) AS DECIMAL(18,4))
            / NULLIF(t.QTD_GRUPO, 0)
            AS DECIMAL(7,4)
        ),
        NULL,
        CASE
            WHEN s.CD_GRUPO IN (
                'MODA',
                'SAUDE_BELEZA',
                'FAMILIA_PRESENTES'
            )
            AND s.DS_CELULA_TESTE IN (
                'SEG-A',
                'SEG-B',
                'SEG-C'
            )
            THEN
                CASE
                    WHEN ABS(
                        CAST(COUNT(*) AS DECIMAL(18,4))
                        / NULLIF(t.QTD_GRUPO, 0)
                        - CASE
                            WHEN s.DS_CELULA_TESTE IN (
                                'SEG-A',
                                'SEG-B'
                            ) THEN 0.45
                            ELSE 0.10
                          END
                    ) > 0.03
                    THEN 'ALERTA'
                    ELSE 'OK'
                END
            WHEN s.CD_GRUPO = 'GENERICO'
                AND s.DS_CELULA_TESTE IN (
                    'GEN-A',
                    'GEN-C'
                )
            THEN
                CASE
                    WHEN ABS(
                        CAST(COUNT(*) AS DECIMAL(18,4))
                        / NULLIF(t.QTD_GRUPO, 0)
                        - CASE
                            WHEN s.DS_CELULA_TESTE = 'GEN-A'
                            THEN 0.90
                            ELSE 0.10
                          END
                    ) > 0.03
                    THEN 'ALERTA'
                    ELSE 'OK'
                END
            ELSE 'ALERTA'
        END,
        'Proporcao na safra, conferir desvios e celulas ausentes'
    FROM VDV_SAFRA s
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT
            CD_GRUPO,
            COUNT(*) AS QTD_GRUPO
        FROM VDV_SAFRA
        WHERE ID_SAFRA = 'VDV_2026_11_BF'
        GROUP BY CD_GRUPO
    ) t
        ON t.CD_GRUPO = s.CD_GRUPO
    WHERE s.ID_SAFRA = 'VDV_2026_11_BF'
    GROUP BY
        s.CD_GRUPO,
        s.DS_CELULA_TESTE,
        t.QTD_GRUPO

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        6,
        'POOL',
        g.GRUPO,
        'TODAS',
        COUNT(DISTINCT
            CASE
                WHEN o.ID IS NOT NULL
                THEN UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(o.MARCA)))
            END
        ),
        NULL,
        NULL,
        CASE
            WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT
                CASE
                    WHEN o.ID IS NOT NULL
                    THEN UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(o.MARCA)))
                END
            ) >= 3
            THEN 'OK'
            ELSE 'ALERTA'
        END,
        'Marcas validas nas posicoes 1 a 6, minimo 3'
    FROM (
        SELECT 'MODA' AS GRUPO

        UNION ALL

        SELECT 'SAUDE_BELEZA'

        UNION ALL

        SELECT 'FAMILIA_PRESENTES'

        UNION ALL

        SELECT 'GENERICO'
    ) g
    LEFT JOIN VDV_POOL_OFERTAS_GRUPO_POSICAO p
        ON p.GRUPO = g.GRUPO
        AND p.VERSAO = 'BF26_V1_' + CONVERT(
            VARCHAR(8),
            CONVERT(DATE, DATEADD(HOUR, 3, GETDATE())),
            112
        )
        AND p.VERSAO_TEMA = 'BF26_V1'
        AND p.CELULA = 'TODAS'
        AND p.ATIVA = 1
        AND p.POSICAO BETWEEN 1 AND 6
    LEFT JOIN BRIEFING_OFERTAS_VISA o
        ON o.ID = p.OFERTA_ID
        AND o.TIPO = 'OFERTA'
        AND o.ATIVA = 1
        AND LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(o.MARCA))) > 0
        AND LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(o.FOTO))) > 0
        AND LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(o.LINK))) > 0
        AND LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(o.VALOR))) > 0
        AND (
            o.INICIO IS NULL
            OR o.INICIO <= CONVERT(
                DATE,
                DATEADD(HOUR, 3, GETDATE())
            )
        )
        AND (
            o.FIM IS NULL
            OR o.FIM >= CONVERT(
                DATE,
                DATEADD(HOUR, 3, GETDATE())
            )
        )
    GROUP BY g.GRUPO

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        7,
        'APTOS_TOTAL',
        'TOTAL',
        'TODAS',
        COUNT(*),
        NULL,
        NULL,
        CASE
            WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 'OK'
            ELSE 'ALERTA'
        END,
        'Audiencia preparada, nao comprova envio'
    FROM VDV_APTOS

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        8,
        'APTOS',
        a.CD_GRUPO,
        a.DS_CELULA_TESTE,
        COUNT(*),
        NULL,
        NULL,
        CASE
            WHEN SUM(
                CASE
                    WHEN a.ID_SAFRA = 'VDV_2026_11_BF'
                        AND a.DS_CELULA_TESTE IN (
                            'SEG-A',
                            'SEG-B',
                            'GEN-A'
                        )
                    THEN 0
                    ELSE 1
                END
            ) = 0
            THEN 'OK'
            ELSE 'ALERTA'
        END,
        'Audiencia por grupo e celula'
    FROM VDV_APTOS a
    GROUP BY
        a.CD_GRUPO,
        a.DS_CELULA_TESTE

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        9,
        'APTOS_INVALIDOS',
        'TOTAL',
        'TODAS',
        COUNT(*),
        NULL,
        NULL,
        CASE
            WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 'OK'
            ELSE 'ALERTA'
        END,
        'Esperado zero, safra, rodada, contato ou alocacao invalidos'
    FROM VDV_APTOS a
    LEFT JOIN VDV_SAFRA s
        ON s.CPF = a.CPF
        AND s.ID_SAFRA = a.ID_SAFRA
    WHERE
        a.ID_SAFRA IS NULL
        OR a.ID_SAFRA <> 'VDV_2026_11_BF'
        OR a.DS_CELULA_TESTE IS NULL
        OR a.DS_CELULA_TESTE NOT IN (
            'SEG-A',
            'SEG-B',
            'GEN-A'
        )
        OR a.ID_VERSAO_OFERTAS IS NULL
        OR a.ID_VERSAO_OFERTAS <> 'BF26_V1_' + CONVERT(
            VARCHAR(8),
            CONVERT(DATE, DATEADD(HOUR, 3, GETDATE())),
            112
        )
        OR a.EMAIL IS NULL
        OR LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(a.EMAIL))) = 0
        OR s.CPF IS NULL
        OR s.CD_GRUPO IS NULL
        OR a.CD_GRUPO IS NULL
        OR s.CD_GRUPO <> a.CD_GRUPO
        OR s.DS_CELULA_TESTE IS NULL
        OR s.DS_CELULA_TESTE <> a.DS_CELULA_TESTE
        OR a.DT_ATUALIZACAO IS NULL
        OR CONVERT(DATE, a.DT_ATUALIZACAO) <> CONVERT(
            DATE,
            DATEADD(HOUR, 3, GETDATE())
        )

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        10,
        'ELEGIVEL_SMS',
        'TOTAL',
        'TODAS',
        COUNT(*),
        NULL,
        NULL,
        'INFO',
        'Contato celular disponivel, nao valida consentimento SMS'
    FROM VDV_APTOS
    WHERE
        ID_SAFRA = 'VDV_2026_11_BF'
        AND FL_BLOQ_CELULAR = 0
        AND LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(NR_CELULAR))) > 0
        AND DS_CELULA_TESTE IN (
            'SEG-A',
            'SEG-B',
            'GEN-A'
        )
) f
